01-2.author: Johannes Kepler
01-2.caption: Title page of Johannes Kepler's Somnium ("The Dream"), a story about the Moon printed in 1634.

01-3.caption: Landscape with the Fall of Icarus: a farmer keeps ploughing while Icarus's legs splash into the sea (bottom right).

02-2.caption: The "fire dragon issuing from the water" from the Huolongjing: a dragon-shaped two-stage rocket that fires arrows from its mouth.

02-3.caption: A rebuilt Korean hwacha cart loaded with rocket arrows; this style could launch about 100 arrows at once.

03-1.file: Mysore rocket man, by Robert Home (watercolour).jpg
03-1.author: Robert Home
03-1.caption: Watercolour by Robert Home of a soldier of Tipu Sultan's Mysore army lifting an iron rocket on a long bamboo pole.

03-2.author: Sir William Congreve, 2nd Baronet
03-2.caption: William Congreve's own drawing of his rockets in many sizes, each fixed to a long guide stick.

03-3.file: John Bower - A View of the Bombardment of Fort McHenry - Google Art Project.jpg
03-3.author: John Bower
03-3.caption: John Bower's 1814 print of British ships bombarding Fort McHenry near Baltimore, with shells arcing through the sky.

04-1.author: Henri de Montaut / François Pannemaker
04-1.caption: Engraving from Jules Verne's From the Earth to the Moon: the giant flag-decked Moon projectile arrives on a railway car.

04-2.caption: Konstantin Tsiolkovsky with his white beard in 1934, photographed in front of a log wall in Kaluga.

05-1.author: Esther C. Goddard
05-1.caption: Robert Goddard in a heavy coat beside his first liquid-fuelled rocket and its launch frame in the snow at Auburn, 1926.

05-2.caption: Robert Goddard with one of his rockets in his workshop at Roswell, New Mexico, in October 1935.
